title: 6AM PRAYER THAT MAKES YOUR ENEMIES CONFUSED ALL DAY
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Oh, glory to God. Glory to God. Glory to God. Can you just lift your hands wherever you are right now? I want you to know that this is not an ordinary morning. This is not just another prayer session. Something is about to happen. The spirit of God is already moving. I can sense it. I can feel it. Heaven is paying attention to this gathering. Before we go any further, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this message with someone. Send the link to somebody. Post it on your status. Let someone else encounter what you are about to encounter. You might be the instrument God uses to change somebody's life today. You might be the reason someone's destiny gets unlocked. You might be the vessel through which deliverance comes to a family. So share this. Don't keep it to yourself. Let God use you as a channel of blessing. Now lift your hands and let's worship. We worship you Lord. We worship you. You are the alpha and the omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last. There is none like you in all the earth. There is none like you in the heavens. You are seated above every principality. You are seated above every power. You are seated above every ruler of the darkness of this world. Sing it now. We bow down. We bow down before your throne of grace. We bow down. We bow down to seek your face. Oh hallelujah. Hallelujah. You are worthy, Lord. You are worthy. Every angel bows before you. Every elder cast their crown. The four living creatures cried day and night, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come. We worship you this morning. We worship you not because of what you will do. We worship you because of who you are. You are Jehovah. You are the I am that I am. You are the self-existing one. You need no permission to be God. You need no validation to be king. You are sovereign. You are supreme. You are majestic. Singing holy, holy, holy is the Lord. Holy, holy, holy is the Lord. Let that worship rise, saints. Let it rise. Don't hold back. Don't be timid. This is not the time to be religious. This is the time to pour out your heart. This is the time to let your spirit connect with the spirit of God. Oh, we worship you, Father. We worship you. Singing, "There is none like you. There is none like you in all the earth. In all the earth, there is none like you. There is none like you." [music] Hallelujah. >> Hallelujah. You are the God who parted the Red Sea. You are the God who shut the mouths of lions. You are the God who walked with Shedra, Meshach, and Abednego in the fire. You are the God who raised Lazarus from the dead. You are the God who turned water into wine. You are the God who multiplied five loaves and two fishes. You are the God who made the sun stand still. You are the God who sent fire from heaven. We worship you. We worship you. We worship you singing. I will worship you. I will worship you with all of my heart, with all of my heart. I will worship you. I will worship you with all of my strength, with all of my strength. Oh, glory to God. I feel the presence. I feel the anointing. The atmosphere is shifting. The heavens are opening. Angels are descending. Grace is being released. Holy Spirit, we welcome you. We welcome you. Take over this service. Take over this prayer session. Let your power fall. Let your fire burn. [music] Let your glory manifest. Singing. Spirit of the living God, fall aresh on me. Spirit of the living God, fall aresh on me. Melt me, mold me, fill me, use me. Spirit of the living God, fall aresh on me. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Can you feel that? Can you sense it? The king is in this place. The Almighty is present. The creator of heaven and earth has turned his attention to this gathering singing, "Welcome, Holy Spirit. Welcome to this place. Welcome, Holy Spirit. We've prepared a place for you." Oh, we've prepared a place for you, Lord. Our hearts are open. Our spirits are yielded. Our minds are focused. We are not distracted. We are not divided. We are here fully present, fully surrendered, singing, have your way. Have your way. Have your way [singing and music] in this place. Have your way. Have your way. Have your way in our lives. Glory. Glory. Glory. Thank you Lord. Thank you father. [music] Thank you Holy Spirit. Now I want you to remain in that posture of worship. Keep your hands lifted. Keep your heart open because what I'm about to share with you is not just information. It is revelation. It is not just teaching. It is impartation. Listen to me carefully. There is something about the early morning hours. There is something about the 6:00 a.m. [music] prayer. There is something about rising before the sun rises to seek the face of God. Open your Bible with me to Psalm 5:3. The Bible says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." Did you see that? In the morning, [music] in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee. David understood something. David understood that the morning hours carry a unique spiritual significance. The morning is when heaven is most accessible. The morning is when the gates of mercy are wide open. The morning is when the forces of darkness are most vulnerable. Now listen to this. Turn with me to Psalm 55:17. The Bible says, "Evening and morning and at noon will I pray and cry aloud and he shall hear my voice." Three prayer watches, evening, morning and noon. But there is something special about the morning watch. The morning watch is the watch of new beginnings. The morning watch is the watch of fresh mercies. The morning watch is the watch of divine visitation. Let me tell you why the 6:00 a.m. prayer is so powerful. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are setting the spiritual tone for the entire day. You are establishing your authority before the activities of the day begin. You are positioning yourself for divine protection, divine guidance, divine favor, and divine intervention before you step out of your house. But more than that, when you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are releasing confusion into the camp of your enemies. Are you hearing me? Confusion. Confusion. Confusion. The Bible says in Exodus 14:4, "And it came to pass that in the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud and troubled the host of the Egyptians." Did you see that? In the morning watch, in the morning watch, God troubled the enemies of Israel. In the morning watch, God confused the Egyptians. In the morning, watch God disorganize the plans of Pharaoh's army. And I prophesy to someone here this morning. Every enemy that has been pursuing you, every enemy that has been tormenting you, every enemy that has been blocking your progress in this morning, watch the Lord shall trouble them. Hallelujah. You see, the devil is strategic. The kingdom of darkness is organized. Witches and wizards hold meetings. Covens gather in the night. Evil altars are raised in the darkness. Wicked decrees are made while men sleep. But when you rise at 6:00 a.m. to pray, you are interrupting their plans. You are disrupting their strategies. You are scattering their councils. [music] You are releasing divine interference into the affairs of darkness. Let me show you something in the book of 2 Samuel 17:14. The Bible says, "And Abselum and all the men of Israel said, the council of Hushi the Akite is better than the council of Ahitoll. For the Lord had appointed to defeat the good council of Ahitoll to the intent that the Lord might bring evil upon Abselum." Are you seeing this? God can defeat the counsel of your enemies. God can confuse the wisdom of those who plot against you. God can frustrate the devices of those who scheme against your destiny. And that is what happens when you pray at 6:00 a.m. You activate the confusion of God against every enemy of your destiny. I prophesy to someone here. [music] Every counsel that has been raised against you in the kingdom of darkness, I decree divine defeat upon that counsel now. Hallelujah. Now, let me take you deeper. Turn with me to the book of Isaiah chapter 19:2. The Bible says, "And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians, [music] and they shall fight everyone against his brother and everyone against his neighbor, city against city, and kingdom against kingdom." Did you see that? God can turn your enemies against each other. God can cause confusion in the camp of those who rise against you. God can make your adversaries fight among themselves. This is the power of the 6:00 a.m. prayer. When you pray in the morning watch, you are releasing a spirit of confusion into the camp of your enemies. You are causing them to turn on each other. You are causing their plans to backfire. You are causing their strategies to collapse. Let me tell you something. Your enemies have meetings. Yes, they do. Wicked people gather to discuss how to destroy you. Envious people come together to plot your downfall. Witches fly at night to release arrows against your destiny. But when you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are sending fire into their meetings. You are sending confusion into their discussions. You are sending destruction into their gatherings. I decree over your life right now, every meeting of darkness that has been convened against you, let there be confusion. Let there be confusion. Let there be confusion. Hallelujah. The Bible says in Genesis 11 7 to8 go to let us go down and there confound their language that they may not understand one another's speech. So the Lord scattered them abroad from dens upon the face of all the earth and they left off to build the city. Are you seeing this? When men gathered to build the tower of Babel, God confused their language. God disrupted their unity. God scattered their efforts. And I speak to every tower that has been built against [music] your destiny. Every altar that has been erected against your progress, every foundation that has been laid against your success. I release the confusion of Babel upon them. Now, glory to God. Now, listen to me. This is important. Your 6 a.m. prayer is not just about reciting words. [music] It's not just about fulfilling a religious ritual. It's about engaging in spiritual warfare. It's about taking authority over the day. It's about establishing dominion before the activities of life begin. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are not just talking to God. You are making decrees. You are releasing commands. You are establishing your will according to the will of heaven. The Bible says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." Did you see that? Thou shalt decree a thing. You have been given authority to decree. You have been given power to establish. You have been given dominion to command. And when you exercise this authority at 6:00 a.m. before the sun rises, before the world wakes up, before the noise of the day begins, your decrees carry maximum weight. Let me tell you why. The early morning hours are the hours when the spiritual gates are most open. The early morning hours are when the forces of darkness are transitioning from their night activities. The early morning hours are when heaven is most attentive to the prayers of the righteous. Jesus understood this. Look at Mark 1:35. And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed a great while before day. Jesus rose early. Jesus prayed before sunrise. Jesus understood the power of the morning watch. If the son of God found it necessary to pray in the early morning hours, how much more should we? >> Hallelujah. Now, let me show you something else. The Bible says in Psalm 90:14, "Oh, satisfy us early with thy mercy that we may rejoice and be glad all our days. satisfy us early, early, not late in the afternoon, not at midnight, but early in the morning. When you seek God early, you receive his mercy for the entire day. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are downloading grace for every challenge you will face. You are receiving strength for every battle you will encounter. You are accessing wisdom for every decision you will make. But more importantly, you are releasing confusion upon every enemy that would try to attack you throughout the day. I want you to understand something. Your enemies have plans for you today. Yes, they do. There are people who woke up this morning thinking about how to harm you. There are forces that were assigned against you before you opened your eyes. There are arrows that were released in the night scheduled to land in your day. But when you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are intercepting those arrows. You are cancelling those plans. You are destroying those assignments. I prophesy to you right now. Every arrow that was released against you in the night, I command those arrows to return to send. Every plan [music] that was made against you in the darkness, I decree divine cancellation. Every assignment that was given to demons concerning your life, I declare divine frustration. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now, let's pray. I want you to lift your hands right now. Open your mouth. This is not the time to be silent. This is the time to roar like a lion. This is the time to thunder like the voice of God. This is the time to release fire from your belly. Father, I thank you for this morning. I thank you for the privilege of prayer. I thank you for the access we have to your throne. I thank you for the authority you have given us in the name of Jesus. Now in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I come against every plan of the enemy that has been made, against everyone under the sound of my voice, every witchcraft meeting that was held last night concerning any destiny represented here. I release confusion into that meeting now. Every covenant that gathered to plot against anyone praying here this morning, I scatter that gathering by fire. Every evil council that was convened to discuss how to bring someone down, I frustrate that counsel by the blood of Jesus. Pray with me. Open your mouth and pray. I decree confusion upon my enemies. I release confusion into every camp that is against me. Let every tongue that rises against me in judgment be confused. Let every hand that rises against me be paralyzed. Let every plan against my destiny backfire. Hallelujah. Pray in the spirit now. Release tongues of fire. Shabba raba katia chandela koroba shendi kayala fira lakanda shabolo katima roshenda kayaba. Fire fire fire. I release fire into the camp of my enemies. I release confusion into the kingdom of darkness. I decree that every satanic agent assigned against my life be confused RIGHT NOW. PRAY. PRAY. PRAY. FATHER, LET EVERY STRATEGY OF HELL AGAINST MY FAMILY be scattered. Let every weapon fashioned against my marriage be destroyed. Let every arrow fired at my finances missed the target. Let every attack against my health be nullified in the name of Jesus. I receive power. I receive authority. I receive dominion. Every enemy of my progress be confused. Every enemy of my breakthrough be scattered. Every enemy of my testimony be destroyed in the name of Jesus Christ. Now listen to me. I want you to pray specifically for your day. I want you to cover every hour of this day with the blood of Jesus. From 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon, from 12:00 noon to 6:00 p.m., from 6:00 p.m. to midnight, lift your voice and decree, I cover this day with the blood of Jesus. No weapon formed against me today shall prosper. No arrow released against me today shall find its mark. No plan of the enemy shall succeed against me today. This is my day of victory. This is my day of favor. This is my day of breakthrough. This is my day of testimony. Pray in tongues. Shalom. I [music] prophesy. I prophesy. I prophesy today. Doors that were closed against you shall open today. Opportunities that were hidden from you shall be revealed today. People who were supposed to help you shall remember you today. Favor shall locate you in unexpected places. [music] Decree it. I walk in favor today. I walk in grace today. I walk in victory today. I walk in dominion today. Hallelujah. >> Now, let's go deeper. I sense in my spirit that there are people here who have been under a season of consistent attacks. Every time you seem to be making progress, something happens to pull you back. Every time you seem to be rising, something happens to bring you down. Every time you seem to be breaking through, something happens to block you. Listen to me. That pattern is about to be broken. That cycle is about to be destroyed. That yoke is about to be shattered. The Bible says in Isaiah 10:27, "And it shall come to pass in that day that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing." The anointing destroys yolks. The anointing breaks cycles. The anointing shatters patterns of defeat. And I release that anointing upon your life right now. Every yoke of consistent failure, I break you now in Jesus name. Every pattern of near success syndrome, I destroy you now in Jesus name. Every cycle of almost dear frustration, I shatter you now in Jesus name. Pray with fire. I break every yoke. I destroy EVERY PATTERN. I SHATTER every cycle. I demolish every stronghold in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Shaborint simoa. I hear the Lord saying something to someone right now. The Lord says the season of almost is over. The season of nearly is finished. The season of close but not quite is terminated. This is your season of completion. This is your season of fulfillment. This is your season of full manifestation. What God started in your life, he shall complete. What God promised you, he shall deliver. What God destined for you, he shall manifest. Receive it. Receive it. Receive it. Now, let's deal with something else. There are people here who have been experiencing strange setbacks. Things that should work for you don't work. Things that should favor you don't favor. Things that should bless you don't bless. Let me tell you what is happening. There is an altar speaking against you. There is a voice from your foundation contending against your progress. There is a covenant from your bloodline hindering your advancement. But today we are going to silence that altar. We're going to shut that voice. We're going to break that covenant. The Bible says in Colossians chapter 2:14, blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross. Jesus nailed every ordinance against you to the cross. Jesus canled every handwriting of the enemy. Jesus blotted out every evil decree. And today we are going to enforce that victory in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. I address every evil altar that is speaking against anyone under the sound of my voice. Every altar of witchcraft, I silence you now. Every altar of divination, I destroy you now. Every altar of familiar spirits, I demolish you now. Every altar of ancestral worship, I scatter you now. Fire. Fire. fire. Pray with violence. Pray with aggression. Pray with holy anger. I silence every evil altar. I break every evil covenant. I cancel every evil decree. I nullify every evil pronouncement in the name of Jesus. Shabory kosha labyo fasha tandela kayaba shimora. Let me tell you something. Your grandfather may have entered a covenant. Your grandmother may have made a sacrifice. Your parents may have visited a shrine. Someone in your bloodline may have opened a door to darkness. But today, that door is being shut. That covenant is being broken. That sacrifice is being nullified. That curse is being destroyed. The Bible says in Galatians 3:13, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a cause for us. For it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree. You have been redeemed from every curse. You have been delivered from every bondage. You have been set free from every chain. Declare it. I am redeemed. I am delivered. I am set free. No curse can hold me. No covenant can BIND ME. NO ALTAR CAN STOP ME in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now let me speak to those who are dealing with enemies in the physical realm. You have people who hate you for no reason. You have colleagues who are envious of you. You have relatives who are working against your progress. You have neighbors who are monitoring your movements. Listen to me. The 6:00 a.m. prayer is your weapon against all of them. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are releasing confusion into their camp before they even wake up. [music] When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are frustrating their plans before they even begin to execute them. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are scattering their strategies before they even finalize them. The Bible says in Psalm 35:es 4-6, let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul. Let them be turned back and brought to confusion that divides my heart. Let them be as chaff before the wind. and let the angel of the Lord chase them. Let their way be dark and slippery. [music] And let the angel of the Lord persecute them. Did you hear that? Let them be confused. [music] Let them be turned back. Let them be as chaff before the wind. Let the angel of the Lord chase them. This is what your 6 a.m. prayer accomplishes. It releases the angels of the Lord to chase your enemies. It causes confusion in the camp of those who plot against you. [music] It makes the way of the wicked dark and slippery. I decree right now, every person who has been plotting against your promotion, let them be confused. Every person who has been scheming against your marriage, let them be scattered. Every person who has been working against your business, let them be put to shame. Every person who has been monitoring your life for evil, [music] let the angel of the Lord chase them. Pray. Open your mouth and pray. I release confusion upon every enemy. I release confusion upon every adversary. I release confusion upon every opposer. I release confusion upon every accuser in the name of Jesus Christ. Shabory fire. Let every plan against my life backfire. Let every strategy against my destiny collapse. Let every weapon against my progress destroy itself in Jesus mighty name. >> Hallelujah. >> Now let me tell you something about the God we serve. Our God is a man of war. The Bible says in Exodus 15:3, "The Lord is a man of war. The Lord is his name. Our God does not sit idly by when his children are being attacked. Our God does not remain silent when his people are being oppressed. Our God arises. Our God fights. Our God delivers. And when God arises, his enemies are scattered. Psalm 68:1 says, "Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him." Let God arise. When God arises in your situation, your enemies cannot stand. When God arises on your behalf, those who hate you will flee. When God arises for your cause, every opposition will crumble. Pray this prayer with me. Father, arise for me. Arise and let my enemies be scattered. Arise and let those who hate me flee before me. Arise and let every opposition against my life crumble. Pray it with fire. Let God arise. Let God arise. Let God arise. Scatter my enemies, oh Lord. Scatter those who plot against me. Scatter those who scheme against my family. Scatter those who walk against my destiny in the name of Jesus. Shabory kosha. I prophesy to someone right now. The enemies you see today, you shall see them no more. The opposition you face today, it shall crumble before your eyes. The barriers before you today, they shall become bridges. This is your day of victory. Hallelujah. Now, let's talk about divine preservation. One of the powerful things about the 6:00 a.m. prayer is that it activates divine preservation over your life for the entire day. When you pray in the morning, you are putting on the armor of God before you step out. You are activating the hedge of protection around you. You are deploying angels to go before you and behind you. The Bible says in Psalm 91 11 to12, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone." Angels are assigned to you. Angels are commissioned to protect you. Angels are deployed to preserve you. But these angels are activated by prayer. These angels are mobilized by faith. These angels are commanded by your decrees in the name of Jesus. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are commanding your angels to take their positions. You are directing them to go before you into your day. You are instructing them to protect you from every danger, every accident, every attack. I decree right now, angels of the living God, take your positions around everyone connected to this prayer. Go before them into every meeting. Go beside them into every journey. Go behind them as a rare guard. Protect them from every evil. Preserve them from every danger in the name of Jesus Christ. Pray for preservation. Father, preserve me today. Preserve my family. preserve my children. Preserve my spouse. Preserve my parents. Let no accident befall us. Let no evil touch us. Let no sickness strike us. Let no weapon prosper against us in Jesus name. I cover my going out and my coming in. I cover my sitting down and my rising up. I cover my sleeping and my waking by the blood of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, by the authority of the name of Jesus. I am preserved. My family is preserved. My household is preserved. Hallelujah. Now, let me speak to those who are dealing with spiritual attacks in their dreams. Some of you have been having strange dreams. Dreams of being chased. Dreams of being attacked. Dreams of eating strange food. Dreams of seeing dead relatives. Dreams of swimming in rivers. Dreams of flying. Dreams of being in your village. These are not ordinary dreams. These are spiritual attacks. These are manipulations from the kingdom of darkness. These are attempts by the enemy to steal your virtues, manipulate your destiny, and afflict your soul. But listen to me. The 6:00 a.m. prayer is your weapon of recovery. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are reversing every evil that happened in your dreams. You are recovering every virtue that was stolen. You are cancelling every covenant that was made without your consent. You are destroying every manipulation that took place in the spirit realm. The Bible says in Joel 2:2, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmer, my great army which I sent among you." God is a God of restoration. What the enemy stole, God can restore. What the locust at, God can [music] give back. What darkness took, light can recover. I decree right now every virtue that has been stolen from you in the dream, I command restoration. Every good thing that was taken from you while you slept, I command release. Every glory that was manipulated in the spirit realm, I command recovery in the name of Jesus Christ. Pray for restoration. Father, restore my virtues, restore my glory, restore my destiny, restore my blessings. Everything that was stolen from me in the dream, I recover now. Every good thing that was taken from me while I slept, I take it back now in Jesus mighty name. I cancel every evil dream. I reverse every satanic manipulation. I nullify every dark covenant. I destroy every dreambased [singing and music] attack by the blood of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, by the fire of God. I am restored. I am recovered. I am made whole. Hallelujah. No advancement, no recognition. But today that changes. I decree promotion locates you this week. Favor speaks for you. Doors open. Gatekeepers release you in Jesus name. Now hear me as I bring this to a close. The siege is over. I said the siege is over. Every siege of poverty ended. Every siege of sickness terminated. Every siege of delay broken. Every siege of stagnation destroyed. Shaboroyo. I seal everything we have prayed this morning with the blood of Jesus. Every decree stands. Every declaration is established. Every prayer is answered. Your enemies are confused. They are scattered. They are defeated. All day long. Confusion rest upon them. But you, you walk in clarity. You walk in favor. You walk in victory. You walk in dominion. This week is your week. This month is your month. This season is your season. Testimonies shall flow. Breakthrough shall manifest. Miracles shall abound. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in the authority of the name of Jesus. The Lord goes before you. The Lord goes beside you. The Lord is your rear guard. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. No tongue that rises against you shall stand. It is finished. It is done. It is settled in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. [music] Amen. Amen. And amen. Hallelujah. Go and possess your day. The victory is yours.
